prBody:
## Summary

Families need a clear choice between signing in for backup and using Little Say locally. This adds dedicated login and registration screens at first launch, with an equally available guest option. Settings links back to the account screen instead of embedding forms; sign-out keeps local boards. Guest choices are remembered, and saved sign-ins return directly to the app.

Optional Firebase identity and consent-based PostgreSQL backups restore boards and media across devices while preserving offline use. Backups validate asset hashes, preserve conflicts, enforce quotas and retry deletion. Sessions remain bound to the selected server. The landed native configuration is preserved; deferred OAuth grants are excluded.

Closes #19. Replaces #24; original source and evidence remain retained.

## Test plan and behavior evidence

| Scenario | Expected and observed result |
| --- | --- |
| Launch, choose login/create/guest, then back, cancel or relaunch | Dedicated choices appear; forms cancel without changing data; guest relaunch stays local. Existing guest libraries and failed preference saves retain boards. |
| Open accounts from settings; sign out; switch servers | Settings has navigation, not inline forms. Returning preserves its unsaved draft; sign-out retains boards and opens account choices. Cross-account/server isolation remains enforced. |
| Verify email, restore a fresh device, edit offline and reconnect | Consent and verification gate backup; exact boards and all three media types restore. Conflicting edits remain separate; failed sync preserves local data and recovers. |

All five real account-browser scenarios passed. PostgreSQL17/Auth-emulator integration passed 25 contracts, including integrity, quotas, revision conflicts and durable deletion.

### Before / After

Actual master `1f03290` → head `ddad868`. Genuine browser captures use matched 390×1050 viewports, scale 1, light theme, synthetic data and a shared clock. No capture-only UI hiding or image edits. [Exact source/build/fixture identities and reproduction](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/d5b790cb451c8597c758b4180c58c45d5ee7e495/launch/README.md).

**Launch:** master goes directly to language setup; After offers login, registration and guest continuation first.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: language setup at launch](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/d5b790cb451c8597c758b4180c58c45d5ee7e495/launch/before-launch.png?raw=true) | ![After: dedicated account and guest choices](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/d5b790cb451c8597c758b4180c58c45d5ee7e495/launch/after-launch.png?raw=true) |

**Settings:** After adds a link to the dedicated screen, with no inline authentication fields.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: settings without accounts](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/d5b790cb451c8597c758b4180c58c45d5ee7e495/launch/before-consent-unavailable.png?raw=true) | ![After: settings links to account screens](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/d5b790cb451c8597c758b4180c58c45d5ee7e495/launch/after-settings.png?raw=true) |

**Restore:** the fresh master device has no backup entry; After restores the verified library. Blank thumbnails are deliberate tiny media fixtures; exact restored bytes were asserted.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: empty fresh device](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/d5b790cb451c8597c758b4180c58c45d5ee7e495/launch/before-fresh-device.png?raw=true) | ![After: restored account library](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/d5b790cb451c8597c758b4180c58c45d5ee7e495/launch/after-restored-device.png?raw=true) |

**Additional After states:** dedicated registration discloses backup access before consent; offline failure leaves boards intact, then reconnection completes sync. These are current-head states, not extra baseline comparisons.

| Registration and consent | Offline failure | Recovered |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![After: dedicated registration and consent](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/d5b790cb451c8597c758b4180c58c45d5ee7e495/launch/after-backup-consent.png?raw=true) | ![After: failed sync retains local boards](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/d5b790cb451c8597c758b4180c58c45d5ee7e495/launch/after-offline-retry.png?raw=true) | ![After: sync recovered](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/d5b790cb451c8597c758b4180c58c45d5ee7e495/launch/after-recovered.png?raw=true) |

## Supporting checks and limitations

Release/type checks, 228 unit tests, 73 guest/offline browser scenarios, server/web builds and Android JavaScript export passed. [Current-head CI](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/actions/runs/37541555413) passed at the captured head. Real Google/Apple authorization, hardware SecureStore and native system-back execution remain unverified; browser flows and export are not device proof. Actual GitHub page rendering is [human-waived](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/issues/405#issuecomment-6022754087), not claimed performed. No provider setup, production migration or deployment is included.
issueBody:
## Problem

Families need to recover boards and saved media after reinstalling or moving devices without giving up local offline use. Optional Firebase sign-in enables consent-based backups to the selected server; guest libraries stay local and sign-out keeps downloaded boards.

## Requirements and acceptance

- On mobile launch, offer Log in, Create an account, or Continue without an account on a dedicated account screen; do not make settings the primary entry point.
- Settings must link to the same registration/login/account screen rather than embed authentication forms. Sign-out keeps local boards and returns to account choices.
- Back/cancel, repeated launches, existing guest libraries and saved sign-ins must preserve local data, settings drafts, offline access and explicit server/backup consent.
- Preserve optional, explicit account/server consent; guest/offline SQLite/IndexedDB and local media remain local.
- Provide account lifecycle/session isolation and durable PostgreSQL backups with revision conflicts, asset integrity, complete snapshot restoration, quotas and recoverable deletion.
- Preserve board/media restoration and local data through offline failures/reconnect; test consent and recovery against the actual base.
- Account-only extraction must not activate or depend on the deferred ChatGPT grant feature; preserve original PR11, PR24 and their evidence while coordinator evaluates the independent continuation.
- No provisioning, provider activation, legacy migration, release/deployment or TestFlight work. Real-provider/native validation remains separate.

## Implementation plan

Implement the [requested launch and dedicated-screen navigation](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/29#issuecomment-6025763278). Remember an explicit guest continuation locally, bypass the welcome screen for saved sign-ins and resumed play, and allow later changes through settings. Preserve the merged native configuration from current master.

The pre-created account plan covers Firebase identity and optional PostgreSQL backup. Use the independent account-only implementation from current master; deferred ChatGPT grants are excluded. Preserve the earlier stacked implementation and its evidence; no active PR20 dependency remains.

[Exact original requirements, plan and history](https://github.com/MChartier/agentic-development-workflow/blob/be7f2a00cbf9ced12d4b1a7a52f28e455695d7e3/issue-template-migration/little-say-19-original.md).

## Implementing Codex task


Verified implementing Codex task ID: `01a10f7a-bf1e-7154-8695-468b946d4021`. A shareable task link is not available through the current tools.

## Implementing PR

Current: [PR29 — independent Firebase accounts and optional backups](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/29), based directly on master with deferred OAuth grants excluded. Independent QA remains required. History: [PR24](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/24), [closed superseded PR11](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/11). [Previous issue linkage](https://github.com/MChartier/agentic-development-workflow/blob/81624c0f2981d2ad6c06c319a9cf44a99b32a538/issue-template-migration/issue19-before-pr29.md). Implementation evidence and results belong in PR29.

The experience illustrated here, where accounts are created and logged into from settings, is unintuitive and unfamiliar. On mobile, we should instead present with the option to log in or create an account when the app is launched, or offer the opportunity to continue without creating an account.

Thereafter, it should be possible to access account creation/login, or sign out of a logged-in account from settings, but this should generally link the user back to the account register/login page instead of just being an inline form.
